name: Box Turn (forward half)
notes: Owner's description: the basic waltz step, a quarter turn to the right progressing; the lead starts forward on the right, the feet close on 3, and the turn is felt mostly on 2. Usually followed by Box Turn (backward half). No rise. Turn timing from the book: the partner going forward commences to turn on 1, then 1/8 between 1 and 2 and 1/8 between 2 and 3; the partner going back turns 1/4 between 1 and 2 and completes it on 3. The book's "body turns less" for the follow isn't drawn: pointing her count-2 foot further round lands its toes on the other foot. Reviewed by the owner (2026-11-19).
